{{Quote|We are Children of the Emperor, like her. We understand what it means to be severed from him.|Tannac, about himself and his fellow Children|<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />}}
A [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was a '''Child of the Emperor''', an agent of the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire. Going underground with fellow [[Children of the Emperor|Child]] [[Tannac]] after the supposed [[Death/Legends|death]] of the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]], the Child accompanied Tannac to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]] to retrieve their crazed sibling [[Suri]] and help her block out the wounded Emperor's mental commands.

==Biography==
The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Jedipedia" /> grew up on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]], and during childhood they were brought before the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. The [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] transformed the youth into a [[Children of the Emperor|Child of the Emperor]], an extension of his will.<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" /> In [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Time">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]'' and comments from [[Charles Boyd]] place the [[Battle of Ilum]] and the finales of Act III for the class storylines in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' in [[3640 BBY]]. As "The Emperor's Orphans" occurs after the Emperor's death but is still part of the base game, it must also occur within 3640 BBY.</ref> during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] Empire, the Human went underground with a fellow Child named [[Tannac]] after the apparent [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of the Emperor and the [[Syo Bakarn|First Son]]&mdash;the Child who shielded his siblings from the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] view. Blocking out the mental raging of the wounded Emperor, the Human Child and Tannac tracked down their sibling [[Suri]] on the planet [[Voss]] after she contacted [[Kira Carsen]], a former Child who was now a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Locating Suri in the [[Cave/Legends|cave]] known as the [[Mind healer's grove]], the Human and Tannac interrupted Suri's conversation with Carsen and her former teacher, the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] known as the [[Hero of Tython]], who was responsible for the Emperor's apparent death. Speaking to the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], Tannac convinced the two to let Suri depart with her siblings so that she could learn to block out the Emperor's voice.<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />
{{Endgame}}

==Personality and traits==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] Human, the Child was fair-skinned with [[Color/Legends|red]] facial [[Tattoo/Legends|tattoos]], though they had a set of three scars across the left half of their face, and the Child had brown [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] and black [[Hair/Legends|hair]].<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />

==Equipment==
The Human carried a [[Vibrosword/Legends|vibrosword]] in combat, and they wore tight-fitting, blue-gray [[Robe/Legends|robes]] with an [[Clothing/Legends|overskirt]].<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />

==Behind the scenes==
The unnamed Child first appeared as a non-player character named "'''Tannac's Henchman'''" in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]], during the mission "The Emperor's Orphans" for the Jedi Knight class. If the player chooses to fight Tannac and Suri, which will result in a loss of affection with Carsen, all three Children will die in battle.<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" /> This article assumes that the player chooses only the moral [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] options as a Republic Jedi Knight character<ref name="Light Side">This article assumes that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] alignment points.</ref> and therefore assumes the Child survived.<ref name="The Emperor's Orphans" />
